sections.title: Education
sections.subtitle: Accelerate course creation with EduPilot and connect student services with campus operations.

sections.heading: Education technology services. Connected campuses.
sections.body:
Linkfields combines enterprise platforms, integration, automation and governed Data & AI with EduPilot for rapid course creation. We connect student-service and administrative applications while defining educator and staff decision rights.

Secure-by-design delivery starts with identity, access and student-data boundaries. EduPilot is positioned for course creation, not as a complete learning-management system; supported inputs, outputs and integration fit should be reviewed for your institution.

items.title: Talent Advisory & GCC

sections.heading: What we deliver
sections.description: Start with course preparation or a campus process, keeping educators and staff accountable for decisions.

items.title: Educator-reviewed course creation
items.description: Shape an EduPilot course-creation workflow around your educators’ brief, with supported inputs and review criteria agreed with the product team.
items.bullets:
Control – educators review, edit and approve generated course outputs.
Output – a course-creation workflow and educator acceptance checklist.
items.footText: Preparation effort and revision needs against an agreed baseline.

items.title: Admissions and support hand-offs
items.description: When applicants or students repeat enquiries, connect approved channel interactions with admissions and service teams.
items.bullets:
Control – staff handle decisions and sensitive or exceptional requests.
Output – request ownership, status updates and assisted-channel escalation.
items.footText: Hand-off effort, status clarity and request resolution time.

items.title: Administrative records and approvals
items.description: When records and routine approvals sit in separate systems, connect document search, routing and review with responsible staff.
items.bullets:
Control – authorised staff review records and approve changes.
Output – searchable document sources and traceable approval records.
items.footText: Record-finding effort, approval time and administrative rework.

items.title: Controlled campus integration and analytics
items.description: When campus reports need manual assembly, connect agreed enterprise and student-service sources through governed interfaces.
items.bullets:
Discovery – define data access, accessibility and reporting purposes.
Control – staff review source quality, metric definitions and reconciled reporting outputs.
items.footText: Reporting freshness, completeness and reconciliation effort.

sections.heading: EduPilot and document intelligence
sections.description: Selected Linkfields products for education. Campus integrations and other IP are considered only after fit and controls are confirmed.

items.title: EduPilot
items.description: Rapid course creation for education and corporate learning. Review supported inputs, generated outputs and educator editing in a product walkthrough.
items.footText: Agree the course brief, review workflow and deployment boundary before adoption.

items.title: textIQ
items.description: Intelligent search and insight across unstructured enterprise content. Apply it to approved institutional documents with agreed source access and staff review.
items.footText: Define document scope, permissions and review criteria before connecting sources.

sections.note: Products are available by licence, subscription or SaaS, with or without services. [Buying options](/products-and-accelerators#how-to-buy).

sections.heading: Start with a course-creation or campus workflow
sections.description: Discuss the starting workflow and its constraints, then agree discovery scope, review gates and suitable commercial terms.

items.title: Agree inputs and responsibilities
items.description: An example engagement defines the course brief or campus process, supported sources and responsible educators or staff. Agree student-data permissions and accessibility requirements.
items.bullets:
Artefacts – workflow map and responsibility matrix
Decisions – supported inputs, outputs and deployment boundary

items.title: Review outputs and acceptance
items.description: Evaluate a course-creation workflow through educator review and edits, or validate a campus integration through staff acceptance and reconciled records.
items.bullets:
Artefacts – review checklist, test evidence and acceptance record
Measures – preparation effort, rework or operational hand-offs

items.title: Choose the next engagement
